arguments.body: Hello, thanks for reporting this. Sorry, our system logged it as a fridge issue by mistake. We have corrected it to a front door problem and are treating it as urgent. Until it is looked at, please try not to slam the door, especially if it has glass, and keep children and pets away from it. A few quick questions: 1) Does the front door lock and stay secure when closed, so the property is safe tonight? 2) Is the glass in the door cracked or loose, and is the back door also affected? 3) What days and times suit for access, and are there any alarms, pets or entry codes we should know about? We are asking the landlord to approve a repair and will update you by tomorrow.

arguments.body: Hello, thanks for reporting this. Sorry, our system logged it as a fridge issue by mistake. We have corrected it to a front door problem and are treating it as urgent. Until it is looked at, please try not to slam the door, especially if it has glass, and keep children and pets away from it. A few quick questions: 1) Does the front door lock and stay secure when closed, so the property is safe tonight? 2) Is the glass in the door cracked or loose, and is the back door also affected? 3) What days and times suit for access, and are there any alarms, pets or entry codes we should know about? We are asking the landlord to approve a repair and will update you by tomorrow.
